articles.description: Singapore, November 19: Mastercard today announced two milestones that advance trusted agentic commerce in Asia Pacific: a live consumer transaction through Antom, Ant International's merchant payment and digitalization platform, demonstrating how AI agents can act on verified consumer instructions; and a completed Mastercard Agent Pay for Machines (AP4M) pilot with Antom in Singapore, demonstrating how businesses can control and authorize purchases made by their AI agents.

articles.title: Flash Storage Servers, Delivering PCIe Gen 6 Performance and Broad Software
articles.description: San Jose (California) / Chicago [US], November 19: Supercomputing Conference - Supermicro, Inc. (NASDAQ: SMCI), an AI, Enterprise, Storage, and 5G/Edge Total IT Solution Provider featuring Data Center Building Block Solutions® (DCBBS), today announced new extensions to the broad portfolio of AMD EPYC based all-flash storage servers. The first systems, now shipping, include the Petascale system powered by the 6th Gen AMD EPYC 9006 Series processors (formerly codenamed 'Venice'), with more products to follow as AMD launches new SP8 CPU versions. These are the first storage products supporting the PCIe Gen 6 I/O specification with 100% greater sequential read bandwidth over PCIe Gen 5.
